title: Vibrant Korean-Style Almond Wrap
description: A flavorful and refreshing wrap filled with vibrant Korean-inspired ingredients. Perfect for a light lunch or snack.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together almond butter and Korean chili flakes.
Lay a tortilla wrap flat and spread the almond butter mixture evenly.
Arrange the sliced cucumber, carrot sticks, and vibrant bell pepper on top of the almond butter mixture.
Add sliced Korean pear and sprinkle with sliced almonds.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
